title: Read the Service Log
story: ION: The second assembly wing needs production-grade Python. Restore the machine, then inspect its diagnostics with O.
objective: Define count_errors(path). Open the supplied UTF-8 text file using a with statement. Strip each line and count those starting with the exact case-sensitive prefix ERROR:. Ignore blank lines and other levels. Return the count. Close the file and propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing path.
lesson: A context manager closes a file even if work fails. Iterate over lines instead of assuming a newline format or loading an arbitrary fixed path.
hint: A context manager closes a file even if work fails. Iterate over lines instead of assuming a newline format or loading an arbitrary fixed path.
